annotations.title: Does a tokenized stock hold its share price (paid)

description: Does each token of one share hold that share’s price? Per token: the share on its exchange times the shares the token stands for, against the issuer’s reference and the deepest DEX pool, with the gap now and over the last seven days (worst gap, hours out of band while the exchange was open). PAID, one cent a call over x402; a question that matches no share is refused before any payment. A gap while `marketOpen` is false can be the token trading while the share cannot, and a DEX gap counts only on pools at least `bands.thinPoolUsd` deep. WHY readOnlyHint IS false: calling it WITH an x402 payment authorisation transfers USDC from the caller to us and records a receipt; called without one it changes nothing and answers with the price.

chain.description: Optional network, e.g. base, to read the tokens there only.
